text: Nothing kills respect for a man faster than when he says one thing and does the opposite. But you see it all the time. A guy breaks up with a girl because she crossed his boundaries. A week later, he is back in her arms, pretending nothing happened. That's weakness. If you make a decision, stick with it. If you said it's over, then it's over. Move forward, not backward. It's the same with friends, work, anything in life. If you commit to something, follow through. Because every time you backtrack, you are teaching yourself that your word means nothing. And if your word means nothing to you, why should anyone else respect it? When people know that you stand firm, they think twice before crossing you. Your woman will know that if she disrespects you, you won't just beg her to stop. You'll actually walk away and build a better life without her. That is real strength. And yes, it's hard. But that's how you build character. That's how you become the man who thinks before speaking, who acts with weight, whose decisions actually matter. So here's the rule. Don't just say things, do them. Don't just decide, stand by it. Because if you don't respect your own word, nobody else ever will.
